# Game Idea: Cosmic Drift

A minimalist HTML canvas game where the player pilots a tiny spaceship through an endless field of drifting asteroids.
- **Controls**: Click‑drag or arrow keys to thrust in any direction.
- **Goal**: Survive as long as possible, collecting occasional power‑ups for speed or shield.
- **Lose condition**: The game ends if the ship collides with an asteroid or sails off the canvas boundaries.
- **Win condition**: There is no fixed win; the challenge is achieving the highest survival time/score.

1: // Minimal Cosmic Drift game
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // generate background stars
8:   const starCount = 100;
9:   const stars = Array.from({length: starCount}, () => ({
10:     x: Math.random() * width,
11:     y: Math.random() * height,
12:     radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5
13:   }));
14:   function drawStars() {
15:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
16:     stars.forEach(s => {
17:       ctx.beginPath();
18:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
19:       ctx.fill();
20:     });
21:   }
22:   // sound utilities
23:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
24:   // resume audio context on first user interaction
25:   const resumeAudio = () => { audioCtx.resume(); window.removeEventListener('click', resumeAudio); window.removeEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio); };
26:   window.addEventListener('click', resumeAudio);
27:   window.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio);
28:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
29:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
30:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
31:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
32:     osc.type = 'sine';
33:     osc.connect(gain);
34:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
35:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
36:     osc.start();
37:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
38:   }
39:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
40:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600;
41: 
42:   // Ship with rotation and gradient
43:   // Ship with rotation and gradient
44:   const ship = {
45:     angle: 0, // direction in radians
46: 
47:     x: width / 2,
48:     y: height / 2,
49:     r: 8,
50:     vx: 0,
51:     vy: 0,
52:     thrust: 0.2,
53:     friction: 0.99,
54:     update() {
55:       // update direction angle based on velocity
56:       if (this.vx !== 0 || this.vy !== 0) {
57:         this.angle = Math.atan2(this.vy, this.vx);
58:       }
59:       this.vx *= this.friction;
60:       this.vy *= this.friction;
61:       this.x += this.vx;
62:       this.y += this.vy;
63:       // wrap around edges
64:       if (this.x < 0) this.x = width;
65:       if (this.x > width) this.x = 0;
66:       if (this.y < 0) this.y = height;
67:       if (this.y > height) this.y = 0;
68:     },
69:     draw() {
70:       // draw ship as a rotated triangle with gradient and glow
71:       ctx.save();
72:       ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
73:       ctx.rotate(this.angle);
74:       // glow effect
75:       ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
76:       ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,255,0,0.7)';
77:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-this.r, -this.r, this.r, this.r);
78:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
79:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#004400');
80:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
81:       ctx.beginPath();
82:       ctx.moveTo(this.r, 0);
83:       ctx.lineTo(-this.r, this.r/2);
84:       ctx.lineTo(-this.r, -this.r/2);
85:       ctx.closePath();
86:       ctx.fill();
87:       ctx.restore();
88:     }
89:       ctx.beginPath();
90:       ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
91:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
92:       ctx.fill();
93:     }
94:   };
95: 
96:   // Asteroids
97:   const asteroids = [];
98:   function spawnAsteroid() {
99:     const size = Math.random() * 20 + 10;
100:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
101:     const speed = Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5;
102:     const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
103:     let x, y, vx, vy;
104:     if (side === 0) { x = 0; y = Math.random()*height; vx = speed; vy = Math.sin(angle)*speed; }
105:     else if (side === 1) { x = width; y = Math.random()*height; vx = -speed; vy = Math.sin(angle)*speed; }
106:     else if (side === 2) { x = Math.random()*width; y = 0; vx = Math.cos(angle)*speed; vy = speed; }
107:     else { x = Math.random()*width; y = height; vx = Math.cos(angle)*speed; vy = -speed; }
108:     asteroids.push({x, y, vx, vy, r: size});
109:   }
110:   for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) spawnAsteroid();
111: 
112:   // Input handling
113:   const keys = {};
114:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
115:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
116:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => { canvas.isDragging = true; canvas.dragStart = {x:e.offsetX, y:e.offsetY}; });
117:   canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { canvas.isDragging = false; });
118:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
119:     if (!canvas.isDragging) return;
120:     const dx = e.offsetX - canvas.dragStart.x;
121:     const dy = e.offsetY - canvas.dragStart.y;
122:     ship.vx += dx * 0.01;
123:     ship.vy += dy * 0.01;
124:     canvas.dragStart = {x:e.offsetX, y:e.offsetY};
125:   });
126: 
127:   function update() {
128:     // controls
129:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) { ship.vy -= ship.thrust; playTone(400, 0.05); }
130:     if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s']) { ship.vy += ship.thrust; playTone(300, 0.05); }
131:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) { ship.vx -= ship.thrust; }
132:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) { ship.vx += ship.thrust; }
133: 
134:     ship.update();
135:     // move asteroids
136:     asteroids.forEach(a => { a.x += a.vx; a.y += a.vy; if (a.x < -a.r) a.x = width + a.r; if (a.x > width + a.r) a.x = -a.r; if (a.y < -a.r) a.y = height + a.r; if (a.y > height + a.r) a.y = -a.r; });
137:     // collision check
138:     for (const a of asteroids) {
139:       const dx = a.x - ship.x, dy = a.y - ship.y;
140:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
141:       if (dist < a.r + ship.r) {
142:         // end game
143:         // play collision sound
144:         playTone(100, 0.3);
145:         cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);
146:         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
147:         ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
148:         ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
149:         ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
150:         ctx.textAlign = 'center';
151:         ctx.fillText('Game Over', width/2, height/2);
152:         return;
153:       }
154:     }
155:     // maybe spawn more
156:     if (Math.random() < 0.01) spawnAsteroid();
157:     draw();
158:     animationId = requestAnimationFrame(update);
159:   }
160: 
161:   function draw() {
162:     ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);
163:     drawStars();
164:     ship.draw();
165:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
166:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r*0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
167:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#aaa');
168:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
169:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
170:       ctx.beginPath();
171:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
172:       ctx.fill();
173:     });
174:   }
175: 
176:   let animationId = requestAnimationFrame(update);
177: })();
